# CI-GATE-10M observed baseline

Source: GitHub REST Actions run/job/step metadata and PR changed paths. Collection: 2026-10-24T08:23:17.634417+00:00

Sample: latest run for 17 distinct branches in the latest 300 CI pull_request runs (Oct 18–24), plus latest completed PR #875 failure. This deliberately reduces repeated-head cancellation bias; not a random or volume-weighted population estimate. Includes 16 successful runs, one failure and one incomplete run. Path classification uses the matching branch PR changed paths; historical heads may predate the final PR diff. Head SHAs and original timestamps are retained in raw JSON.

Timing: gate wall = ci-gate.completed_at − workflow.created_at; initial queue = first non-skipped job.started_at − workflow.created_at; execution envelope = ci-gate completion − first job start. Workflow wall uses workflow.updated_at and can include post-gate activity. Per-job queue uses job.created_at → started_at; runner/dependency wait cannot be attributed more precisely without event telemetry. Step times exclude metadata gaps. p95 uses nearest rank ceil(0.95*n), so small groups often return their maximum. Incomplete run excluded from aggregate latency; failures are not passes. No workflows were rerun/cancelled and no logs downloaded.

Latest-300 history: {'incomplete': 1, 'cancelled': 190, 'failure': 38, 'success': 71}; run_attempt distribution {1: 299, 2: 1}. Same-branch new-head retries remain visible in history; run_attempt is GitHub rerun count, not code-fix attempts.

## Actionable interpretation

A global successful gate already takes ~19 minutes. Flutter analyze/test alone is >13 minutes on both wide run #877 and current #875. Splitting only browser proof steps will not achieve a ten-minute gate: test workload needs balanced parallel groups while preserving all selected acceptance. Compose stack startup plus all-feature smoke is another serial >13-minute path. Current #875 also has Space full integration >13 minutes. CI script regressions are currently unbounded in the incomplete run and were the one-hour bottleneck in the latest completed failure; inspect that step separately and do not infer its cause from duration alone. Exact key step timings and job links for wide #877/current #875 are in critical-step-timings.json.

PR #875 run40068145398 remained in_progress/null on a final read-only status recheck after collection finished at 08:23:17Z; created_at was05:55:20Z. Its latency is therefore censored at >=147m57s, despite unchanged updated_at06:15:45Z. Do not interpret updated_at as completion or infer a green gate. The ci-script-tests regression step remained in_progress in the captured jobs. Latest completed failure39971713562 spent3795s inside the same named regression step.

Limitations: representative by distinct branch/scope rather than production frequency; short date window, only one all-wide successful manifest run, no cache hit/miss telemetry, no test-case-level timing, no historical exact-diff reconstruction, no adjusted cold-run experiment. New-head retries/cancellations and incomplete current #875 prevent claiming an optimized gate or green integration. Mean/p95 are observational baselines, not an achieved SLO.
